announcement.title: New agent avatars, Cloud on your account page and steadier group chats
announcement.description:
Fixes: A group conversation no longer gets stuck when one agent’s turn can’t start, and Retry response now works. Cloud settings no longer say subscriptions are paused when they just aren’t available for your account. Antigravity now lists every model Google offers your account, not just one; press Update Antigravity once in its settings to get them.

Improvements: Agents have new animated avatars. Halofy Cloud plans are now managed on the Subscription page of your Halofy account; Settings → Cloud opens it and still shows your plan’s status.

Known issues: Windows installers remain unsigned.
